skill.name: when-reviewing-code-comprehensively-use-code-review-assistant
skill.description: Guides comprehensive pull request reviews with specialist agents for security, performance, style, tests, and documentation.
skill.summary: Coordinate multi-agent pull request reviews with scored findings, quality gates, and auto-fix guidance.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: The audit confirms operational risk from documented npm, npx, shell, and auto-fix workflows. Secret, environment, filesystem, and reconnaissance hits are examples or local-report reads, and no prompt injection was found.

remediation.issue: External command execution is central to the workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Pin third-party CLI versions, document required tools, and require approval before running npx or npm scripts.

remediation.issue: Auto-fix examples can rewrite files and create tests from generated paths.
remediation.suggestion: Add a dry-run mode, quote file paths, validate input file lists, and require users to review diffs before applying fixes.

remediation.issue: CI examples post generated review summaries to pull requests.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to redact sensitive findings before posting review output to public or external repositories.

content.user_title: Review Pull Requests With Specialist Agents
content.value_statement: Large pull requests can hide security, performance, testing, and documentation issues. This skill coordinates focused review passes and produces merge-readiness guidance.
actual_capabilities: Defines separate review phases for security, performance, style, testing, and documentation.
Provides command examples for running lint, audit, coverage, documentation, and review tools.
Uses quality gates and weighted scoring to decide merge readiness.
Shows how to collect findings into report files and CI comments.
Includes auto-fix script patterns for format, lint, and simple test scaffolding.
limitations: Requires local review tools, npm scripts, and agent names that may not exist in every project.
Auto-fix examples can modify files and should be reviewed before execution.
The skill gives review workflow guidance, not verified vulnerability proof.
Large repositories may need narrower scope to avoid slow or noisy analysis.

use_cases.title: Gate a Complex Pull Request
use_cases.description: Run security, performance, style, test, and documentation checks before approving a large change.

use_cases.title: Standardize Review Evidence
use_cases.description: Create consistent scorecards, report files, and blocking issue lists across review teams.

use_cases.title: Improve Test and Quality Coverage
use_cases.description: Find untested files, weak assertions, style violations, and documentation gaps before release.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Pull Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single PR.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review pull request [number] using this skill. Focus on security, performance, style, tests, and documentation. Return blocking issues first.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Risk Areas
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the changed files in [path or PR]. Prioritize authentication, data access, dependency risk, and missing tests. Explain each blocking finding.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Merge Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess merge readiness for [branch or PR]. Produce a score, gate results, required fixes, and nonblocking recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Design a CI Review Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Adapt this review workflow for our CI pipeline. Include approval gates, report artifacts, failure thresholds, and manual approval points for commands.

output_examples.input: Review PR 123 for a payment API change.
output_examples.output: Security has one blocking issue in payment authorization. Tests miss refund edge cases. Merge readiness is below target until those fixes land.

output_examples.input: Assess whether the branch is ready to merge.
output_examples.output: The branch is not ready. Performance and test gates fail. Style issues are auto-fixable, but the database query requires manual work.

output_examples.input: Create a review plan for a large TypeScript service.
output_examples.output: Run review phases by risk area. Start with auth and dependency checks, then coverage, performance, style, and documentation evidence.

best_practices: Run the review on a clean working tree or a disposable branch.
Confirm external commands before running tools that install packages or modify files.
Treat the score as a gate, but verify each blocking finding manually.
anti_patterns: Do not run auto-fix scripts without checking the diff first.
Do not use one score to override confirmed security or test blockers.
Do not run broad scans on unrelated files when the review scope is known.

faq.question: Does this skill replace human code review?
faq.answer: No. It organizes evidence and highlights risks, but reviewers must confirm important findings.

faq.question: Can it run in CI?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes CI workflow examples with score gates and review comments.

faq.question: Does it modify source files?
faq.answer: Some examples show auto-fix commands that can change files. Run them only after approval.

faq.question: Which tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It references npm, npx, ESLint, Prettier, Jest, audit tools, and claude-flow style coordination.

faq.question: Can it find security issues?
faq.answer: It guides security scanning and review checks. Results depend on the project tools and reviewer validation.

faq.question: What is the best first prompt?
faq.answer: Ask for a pull request review with blocking issues first, then request the full scorecard.
